records.cohort_raw: Honest1 franchised Centers that have been operating continuously for at least 1 year as of December 31, 2023 under the same owner (59 locations included)
records.notes: Cohort defined as franchised centers operating continuously for at least 1 year as of 12/31/2023 under the same owner. 59 of 61 franchised locations included; excluded: 1 closed in 2023, 1 not open all 12 months (under reconstruction), 1 not held by same owner for all 12 months. Total franchised system sales: $87,970,193. 24 locations (41%) met or exceeded the average.

records.cohort_raw: Honest1 franchised Centers that have been operating continuously for at least 1 year as of December 31, 2022 under the same owner (60 locations included)
records.notes: Cohort defined as franchised centers operating continuously for at least 1 year as of 12/31/2022 under the same owner. 60 of 62 franchised locations included; excluded: 2 closed in 2022, 1 not open all 12 months (under reconstruction). Total franchised system sales: $84,593,144. 25 locations (42%) met or exceeded the average.

notes: Item 19 discloses annual gross sales for franchised locations for 2023 and 2022. Both cohorts are defined as locations open at least 1 year continuously under the same owner. The cohort_name 'open_12_24mo' is used as the minimum threshold is 1 year (12 months); however, these are not exclusively 12-24 month locations — they are all locations open at least 12 months. The closest schema match is 'open_24_plus_mo' could also apply since many have been open longer, but the stated qualifier is 'at least 1 year' so open_12_24mo is used as the lower bound qualifier. No profitability data is disclosed. Franchisor is H-1 Auto Care, LLC (brand: Honest1).
